name: FIPPA / MFIPPA (Ontario Access and Privacy)
description: Ontario's Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (FIPPA — provincial ministries, agencies, universities, colleges and public hospitals) and Municipal Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (MFIPPA — municipalities, school boards, police services and local boards). A contractor is not itself an institution, but records it creates or holds on an institution's behalf can be in that institution's custody or control, which brings them within scope of access requests and the institution's privacy obligations. The practical consequence is contractual: flow-down clauses requiring safeguards, retention limits, Canadian residency, cooperation with access requests, and notification to the institution on a privacy breach. Oversight is by the Information and Privacy Commissioner of Ontario.
authority: Information and Privacy Commissioner of Ontario (IPC)
scope: Ontario public institutions and their service providers and contractors handling institutional records

families.name: Custody, Control and Contractual Flow-Down
families.description: Whether institutional records held by a contractor are in scope, and what the contract requires.

controls.name: Identify Records in Institutional Custody or Control
controls.description: Records created or held on behalf of a public institution are identified as such, so they can be produced for an access request and are not treated as ordinary commercial records.

controls.name: Flow-Down Privacy and Security Clauses
controls.description: Contract clauses imposing access, privacy, safeguard, residency and audit obligations are identified clause by clause and mapped to the controls that satisfy them.

controls.name: Cooperation with Access Requests
controls.description: A defined route exists for responding to an institution's request for records to satisfy a freedom-of-information request within the statutory timeline.

families.name: Personal Information Handling
families.description: Collection, use, disclosure and retention limits that apply to personal information under institutional control.

controls.name: Collection Limited to Lawful Authority
controls.description: Personal information is collected only where necessary to the properly authorized activity, and only what is needed for it.

controls.name: Use and Disclosure Limits
controls.description: Personal information is used and disclosed only for the purpose for which it was obtained or a consistent purpose, and disclosures are recorded.

controls.name: Security Safeguards for Personal Information
controls.description: Reasonable measures — access control, encryption, secure transmission and secure disposal — protect personal information against unauthorized access, in line with the regulations under both Acts.

controls.name: Retention and Secure Disposal
controls.description: Personal information is retained only as long as required by the institution's retention schedule or contract, then securely destroyed with the destruction recorded.

controls.name: Accuracy and Correction
controls.description: Personal information used for a decision about an individual is accurate and complete, and a correction route exists.

families.name: Operational Obligations
families.description: Residency, breach notification and personnel obligations that commonly appear as contract conditions.

controls.name: Data Residency and Cross-Border Handling
controls.description: Where a contract commits to Canadian storage and processing, the platform configuration implements it and the configuration is evidenced rather than asserted.

controls.name: Privacy Breach Notification to the Institution
controls.description: A privacy breach affecting institutional personal information is reported to the institution promptly per contract, and the institution's own IPC obligations are supported with the facts it needs.

controls.name: Personnel Confidentiality and Screening
controls.description: Personnel with access to institutional information are bound by confidentiality undertakings and screened where the contract requires it.

controls.name: Subcontractor Pass-Through
controls.description: Subcontractors touching institutional information are bound to equivalent obligations, and the institution is informed where required.
